commands:
set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=0cbd181f46661423d1983ad1805f11d6fecc5128; PORT=/dev/cu.usbserial-1130; git fetch --quiet origin mvp/environment-controller; REMOTE_SHA=$(git rev-parse origin/mvp/environment-controller); echo "EXPECTED_SHA=$EXPECTED"; echo "REMOTE_SHA=$REMOTE_SHA"; test "$REMOTE_SHA" = "$EXPECTED"; git reset --hard "$EXPECTED"; LOCAL_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo "LOCAL_SHA=$LOCAL_SHA"; test "$LOCAL_SHA" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; source scripts/source_idf.sh; PROBE=$(esptool.py --port "$PORT" chip_id 2>&1); echo "$PROBE"; grep -q "ESP32-S3" <<<"$PROBE"; OUT=/tmp/stage27c-flash-fallback-20260903-v1; rm -rf "$OUT"; .venv/bin/python tools/stage27c_soak.py --port "$PORT" --output-dir "$OUT" --duration 240 --progress-seconds 30 --expected-sha "$EXPECTED" --strict; echo STAGE27C_FLASH_FALLBACK_SUMMARY; cat "$OUT/summary.json"; .venv/bin/python - "$OUT/soak.ndjson" <<'PY'
import json, sys
rows = [json.loads(line) for line in open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8') if line.strip()]
assert len(rows) >= 10, f'too few soak rows: {len(rows)}'
assert all(r.get('storage_backend') == 'flash' for r in rows), sorted({r.get('storage_backend') for r in rows})
assert all(int(r.get('storage_sd_mounted', -1)) == 0 for r in rows), 'SD unexpectedly mounted during fallback gate'
assert all(int(r.get('storage_flash_mounted', 0)) == 1 for r in rows), 'flash backend not continuously mounted'
assert max(int(r.get('storage_flash_mount_errors', 0)) for r in rows) == 0, 'flash mount errors observed'
assert max(int(r.get('storage_write_errors', 0)) for r in rows) == 0, 'storage write errors observed'
assert max(int(r.get('storage_queue_drops', 0)) for r in rows) == 0, 'storage queue drops observed'
assert max(int(r.get('storage_records_skipped', 0)) for r in rows) == 0, 'storage records skipped observed'
fallbacks = [int(r.get('storage_fallbacks', 0)) for r in rows]
assert max(fallbacks) >= 1, f'fallback activation not observed: {fallbacks}'
written = [int(r.get('storage_records_written', 0)) for r in rows]
assert max(written) - min(written) >= 2, f'flash records did not advance enough: {written}'
print('STAGE27C_FLASH_FALLBACK_OK', {'rows': len(rows), 'fallbacks': max(fallbacks), 'records_written_first': written[0], 'records_written_last': written[-1]})
PY
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
